Bug_Title: MS: Field isn’t final and cannot be protected from malicious code (MS_CANNOT_BE_FINAL)
Bug_Details:
A mutable static field could be changed by malicious code or
       by accident from another package.
  Unfortunately, the way the field is used doesn't allow
  any easy fix to this problem.
Bug_Explanation: The field 'SECRET_NUMBER' is static and mutable, which means it can be changed by malicious code or accidentally from another package.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug() method, which changes the value of the static field SECRET_NUMBER from 42 to 13.
